Class GameState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.states.GameState
Direct Known Subclasses:
ActionResolutionState, EndGameState, SetupGameState, TotemPlacementState
public abstract class GameState extends Object
Abstract base class for the Game State Pattern.

This class defines the common interface for all game phases in Mesos. It provides default implementations that throw an IllegalStateException, preventing players from executing actions that are not allowed in the current phase. Concrete state classes must override only the methods relevant to their specific phase.
